title: 1 m x 1 m sightline truncation either side of a ROW or communal street driveway
text: Walls, fences and other structures truncated or reduced to no higher than 0.75m within a 1m x 1m sightline truncation on either side of a driveway where vehicle access is taken from a right-of-way or communal street (refer Figure 3.7f).

conditions.label: vehicle access from a right-of-way or communal street

replaces.note: current code has only the general 1.5 m truncation

notes: from: ch3 C3.7.9 (unchanged). Applies where vehicle access is taken from a right-of-way or communal street. parking.sightlines.row_truncation_1m is read as the truncation either side of the driveway at the ROW or communal street; site.access_from_rear_row stands for any ROW access.

verified.note: 0.75m and 1m x 1m confirmed. The page triggers on access taken from any right-of-way or communal street; the condition uses site.access_from_rear_row, so a side ROW access is missed (parking.access.street_type == row would match the page).
